payload.updateBody:
Salam,

  • Context: In the 8/17 Med Station onboarding sync, WhatsApp integration was flagged as the last real gap before the 8/24 go-live and Thursday's soft onboarding session. WhatsApp is still connected to Como and needs to move to GHL before any of the built messaging/lead-escalation workflows can actually send anything.
  • Deliverable: Disconnect WhatsApp from Como, then connect it to GHL. Only migrate the one number that's moving over, the rest stay on Como to avoid disrupting current client messaging. Run a full test pass (inbound/outbound, workflow triggers) once connected.
  • Dependencies: This is a partial blocker on Lead Escalation and Reactivation Build, which are built but can't fully activate until WhatsApp is live on GHL. Confirm the WhatsApp Business API plan supports multi-number/multi-CRM before migrating, so Como-side messaging isn't accidentally interrupted.
  • Done: WhatsApp is sending/receiving through GHL on the migrated number, workflows that depend on it (lead escalation, fallback messages) fire correctly in a live test, and Como continues working normally for the numbers that stayed there.

@Ahmed Memon @Ali Shaheer
